tasks.description:

tasks.subject: Task 2: Value model + chokepoints (Inline, alloc/deref/incref/drop, uncounted)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A nullary constructor becomes RVBox (Inline tag) with zero allocations on both backends, synthesized by deref, inert under dup/drop; machine sites untouched.

**Files:** Modify src/Wok/Interp/RC/Value.hs (Addr+Inline Word32, alloc/allocInline, deref, incref, dropAddr, isInline/isUncounted, countedRefs, closureOwnedBoxed, exports); Machine.hs CAF guard; test/Spec.hs + test/rc-cbackend/nullary-zero-alloc.wok; regenerate test/rc-stats-golden/*.expected.

**Verify:** `cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p "rc"'` all RC groups pass.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/Interp/RC/Value.hs", "src/Wok/Interp/RC/Machine.hs", "test/Spec.hs", "test/rc-cbackend/nullary-zero-alloc.wok", "test/rc-stats-golden/"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p \"rc\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Addr gains Inline Word32; isInline/isUncounted exported", "bare nullary => allocs==frees==peak==0 both backends, identical render", "mixed program live==baseline both backends", "shifted stats goldens regenerated, only reductions", "full suite green"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Slot encoding — the 2-bit low tag
tasks.description:
**Goal:** An immediate can live inside a C cell's slot via a 2-bit low tag (00 CAddr / 01 HAddr / 11 Inline), so immediate-bearing constructors stay C-resident.

**Files:** Modify src/Wok/Interp/RC/Value.hs (encodeSlotC, decodeSlotC); test/Spec.hs (rcCBackendSlotProperty refresh + mixed targeted case); Create test/rc-cbackend/mixed-maybe-list.wok.

**Verify:** `cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p "c-backend"'` slot property + parity + targeted pass.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/Interp/RC/Value.hs", "test/Spec.hs", "test/rc-cbackend/mixed-maybe-list.wok"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p \"c-backend\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["round-trip identity incl Inline + negative HAddr via <<2", "three low-tag classes mutually exclusive", "mixed pointer/immediate program C-resident, identical render, live==baseline", "full suite green, no stats golden shift"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: peak-bytes counter + benchmark report + whole-corpus parity
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Track high-water live bytes in the C runtime, surface in --dump-rc-stats, produce the before/after report, confirm whole-corpus oracle green.

**Files:** Modify runtime/wok_rc.h (+wok_stat_peak_bytes), runtime/wok_rc.c (cur_bytes/peak_bytes both builds), src/Wok/Interp/RC/Heap.hs (FFI), app/Main.hs + Machine.hs (--dump-rc-stats peakBytes on C path), runtime/test/wok_rc_bench.c (optional); Create bench/RESULTS.md.

**Verify:** `bash scripts/rc-bench.sh && bash scripts/asan-runtime.sh` table prints; sanitizers clean.

